lines: Fine. I'll put the edge away, for now.
Fine. I will step back and let the anger cool.
Fine. I accept your offer. Keep your hands clear.
Alright. I can stop without pretending I forgot.
We are done for now. Do not make me regret it.
Fine. I will take the offer and lower my guard.
That is enough to end this, not enough to erase it.
Alright. We settle it here and leave it here.
I accept. Give me room to breathe afterward.
Fine. The fight ends before somebody makes it worse.
I will take the settlement. This ends here.
Alright. Hand it over and give me some space.
We can stop. I need time before we speak again.
The offer is fair. I am lowering my weapon.
Fine. No more blows from either of us.
I accept. Walk away while we are both standing.
That settles the damage. The trust will take longer.
Alright. We end it before someone else gets hurt.
Payment accepted. Keep your distance for now.
I will call it settled. Do not start this again.
Wrong measure. It takes {emerald_cost} {emeralds} to set this right.
That is short. Bring {emerald_cost} {emeralds} if you want this settled.
Not enough. If you want peace, bring {emerald_cost} {emeralds} and mean it.
I will not take less than {emerald_cost} {emeralds}.
The offer needs {emerald_cost} {emeralds}, not a hopeful guess.
Bring {emerald_cost} {emeralds} and we can speak plainly.
You are missing part of the payment. It takes {emerald_cost} {emeralds}.
Set down {emerald_cost} {emeralds} or keep walking.
I counted twice. The price is {emerald_cost} {emeralds}.
This does not cover the harm. Bring {emerald_cost} {emeralds}.
You are short. The amount is {emerald_cost} {emeralds}.
That pile does not reach {emerald_cost} {emeralds}.
Add the rest. I asked for {emerald_cost} {emeralds}.
We do not have a settlement until I see {emerald_cost} {emeralds}.
You can count it yourself. I need {emerald_cost} {emeralds}.
The damage comes to {emerald_cost} {emeralds}. This is less.
Bring the balance. The total is {emerald_cost} {emeralds}.
I am not haggling. It takes {emerald_cost} {emeralds}.
There are not enough emeralds here. The price is {emerald_cost} {emeralds}.
Make it {emerald_cost} {emeralds} and then we can end this.
<shake>No</shake>. {payment_items} will not make this right.
Keep {payment_items}. I am not ready to settle.
No. Put {payment_items} away before this gets worse.
Payment means nothing while the danger is still here.
I will not bargain over {payment_items} right now.
The harm has not stopped long enough for a settlement.
Taking {payment_items} would not make us square.
Not now. Give the village room before you offer anything.
I need to know everyone is safe before we discuss payment.
Keep {payment_items}. We are not done with the danger yet.
No offer matters while people are still at risk.
You cannot buy calm in the middle of a threat.
Back away. We can count costs when this is truly over.
I am not reaching for {payment_items} while I still need both hands free.
This is not a market stall. Stop the harm first.
Put it down and leave. We can speak when tempers cool.
No. Safety first, then restitution.
Even a full payment would not settle this while I still cannot trust you.
End the threat. After that, we can discuss {payment_items}.
There will be no deal until the village is secure.
